title: 冰蓋tipping與十年尺度海平面可預測性
statement: 區分長期不可逆tipping風險與decadal sea-level contribution，量observations對future ice loss的約束。
known_result: 2026 Antarctic basin研究量各basin tipping risk；另一Nature Perspective指出2025 loss rate對未來數十年有emergent predictability。
open_gap: basal processes、ocean forcing、model spread、paleo constraints與irreversibility timescale。
first_task: 用簡化ice-loss ensemble做present-rate conditioning，重現conditioning前後projection spread。
validation_limits: decadal predictability不等於long-term tipping已確定。
completion_criterion: 對凍結basin/model ensemble給可驗證decadal forecast並明列long-term irreversibility uncertainty。
screening_note: 2026-09-28 初始有界文獻篩查；每輪需重查最新資料、修訂與事件。OPEN不代表全網無解。

sources.title: Mapping tipping risks from Antarctic ice basins under global warming
Emergent decadal predictability in Antarctic contribution to sea-level rise
